name: ramecast
title: RameCast
description: Cast your screen to Chromecast, smart TVs (DLNA), Roku, AirPlay and Miracast displays from Raycast
author: michaelhazan

commands.name: cast-screen
commands.title: Cast Screen
commands.subtitle: RameCast
commands.description: Find Chromecast, Google TV, DLNA smart TVs, Roku, AirPlay and Miracast displays on your network and cast your screen to one

commands.name: stop-casting
commands.title: Stop Casting
commands.subtitle: RameCast
commands.description: Stop the current screen cast and close the player on the device

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: latency
preferences.title: Latency
preferences.description: Google Cast mirroring only. Auto adjusts the device buffer while you cast: it rises when Wi-Fi drops packets and falls again once the connection is clean.

data.title: Lowest (~0.1 s, 60 fps) – strong Wi-Fi or wired

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: Custom ffmpeg Path
preferences.description: Optional: use your own ffmpeg binary instead of the one RameCast downloads automatically on first use.
